subject.title: fix(agents): verify delivery receipts before display

question: After resolving the branch against current `main`, should OpenClaw adopt evidence-gated replacement of unsupported SMS receipt claims across all agent delivery paths?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes visible assistant output when delivery evidence is missing; this is a compatibility and message-delivery policy choice that tests alone cannot make on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Rebase and retain the guarded behavior
options.body: Resolve the branch, refresh focused proof on the resulting head, and merge if the message-delivery-only guard still applies cleanly.

options.title: Retain unrestricted receipt display
options.body: Decline the replacement behavior if maintainers prefer model-visible delivery statements to remain unchanged when evidence is unavailable.

recommendation.title: Rebase and retain the guarded behavior
recommendation.body: Resolve the branch, refresh focused proof on the resulting head, and merge if the message-delivery-only guard still applies cleanly.
